component.name: Glyphvane
component.summary: Read and edit Markdown notes and vaults

description.p: Glyphvane is a fast, native Markdown editor and viewer. It opens a single file or a whole folder of notes, follows links between them, and renders each document as CommonMark, GitHub Flavored Markdown or Obsidian define it.

ul.li: Reading view, Source view, Split view and Live Preview, which hides markup away from the cursor and draws images, math, tables, code and diagrams in place
Relative links, wikilinks, heading links and block references across the folder, with hover previews, backlinks and a link checker; renaming or moving a note updates its links
Tables, footnotes, callouts, math, Mermaid diagrams, highlighted code, front matter and embeds
Files panel, outline, tags, bookmarks, search with a query language, quick switcher and command palette
Export to HTML and PDF, printing, and copy as rich text
Autosave, crash recovery with compare and merge, version history and remote content only with your consent

screenshot.caption: A note in the Reading view, with a table, highlighted code, math and a Mermaid diagram
Live Preview: markup hides away from the cursor, and images, math, tables and code render in place
Source and preview side by side, scrolling together
Work with a folder of notes: files, outline, backlinks and link previews
Render each document as CommonMark, GitHub Flavored Markdown, Obsidian or Extended
Search the whole folder with a query language
Open Obsidian canvases with cards, groups, edges and a minimap
Bases show notes as tables, grouped and computed from their properties
Export to HTML or PDF with page options and a live preview
Recover unsaved work after a crash and merge it with the file on disk
Every command is in the palette, in light or dark

description.p: Live Preview: an Edit-mode style that hides Markdown markers away from the cursor and draws images, math, task checkboxes, tags, code blocks, tables, diagrams, callouts and embeds in place. A zoom menu in the status bar, more zoom keys, and the zoom level kept between launches.

The first stable release. Glyphvane reads and edits Markdown files and folders of notes, with a Reading view, a Source view and a Split view, link navigation and link checking across the folder, vault search, HTML and PDF export, printing, and read-only Canvas and Bases views. Builds for Linux, macOS and Windows are on GitHub Releases.
